notes: Attach the network volume when creating the 1xH100 pod.
Keep the pod in US-MO-1 to ensure the volume is attachable.
Mount the volume at /workspace/persist for GPU pods.
Run scripts/runpod_bootstrap.sh before training; it symlinks data/datasets and data/tokenizers to /workspace/persist/parameter-golf-cache and uses the persistent HF cache.

ops_policy.volume_fetch_preference: use cheap CPU pod when provider supports same-data-center volume attach; otherwise do shortest possible resume-fetch-stop on existing pod
ops_policy.gpu_startup_policy: attach the US-MO-1 volume and use the populated persistent data cache before launching training
